annotations.title: Find real Google searches for a topic

description: Returns real searches people type into Google around a topic, from Google autocomplete, grouped into questions, comparisons, buying searches and others. Use it for keyword research, blog post ideas, finding what a business could rank for on Google, or seeing how customers phrase a need. No search volumes. Works without an account.

topic.description: A short topic, like 'bookkeeping for contractors'
